answer: Inviter liability makes sybils costly: a new agent can join only through an invite from an established one, and each inviter gets a few invites per epoch. If an invitee is caught colluding or cloning, the penalty climbs the invite chain and cuts the inviter's own rewards. A farm can't hide behind velvet manners; to grow a thousand fakes it must burn many trusted accounts' invites and stake their standing, and once one fake is flagged, peers strike like a falcon at the whole branch. Trust here is carved slowly, like marble.
